alerts.message: There is no default account: register on the sign-up page. Sign-in and activation links are sent by email; until SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT, SMTP_USERNAME, SMTP_PASSWORD and SMTP_FROM_ADDRESS are set, they are only printed in the aptabase service logs.
